title: Noirbank agent mandate
description: Software-enforced spend limits for one Noirbank agent account, rechecked before the owner broadcasts a shielded payment. Not a consensus rule or smart-account constraint.

maxPerTxZatoshis.description: Maximum zatoshis allowed in a single spend. 1 ZEC = 100000000 zatoshis. Must be less than or equal to dailyCapZatoshis.

dailyCapZatoshis.description: Maximum zatoshis that approved spends may total in one UTC day.

recipientAllowlist.description: Unified addresses selected from the owner's payee book. An empty list rejects every recipient.

cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between approved spends. Zero disables the cooldown.

sessionExpiresAt.description: ISO-8601 instant. Spends after this moment are rejected until the owner saves a new policy.
